groups.eyebrow: The right help for your home
groups.heading:
Big on the details.
Useful in every room.
groups.description: Start with what you need. From a single installation to a whole list of improvements, here’s how I can help.

items.title: TV mounting & home audio
items.tagline: A cleaner setup. A better movie night.
items.description: From a Samsung Frame to your everyday living-room TV, get a thoughtfully positioned screen, organized cables and sound that fills the room.

items.title: Smart home installation
items.description: Get your devices installed, connected and explained, so everyday conveniences actually feel convenient.

bullets.text: Device setup, schedules and app walkthroughs

items.title: Wi-Fi, networks & cameras
items.description: Connect the rooms you use and keep an eye on your property with a network and camera setup built around your space.

bullets.text: Eero, Deco and Google mesh Wi-Fi
PoE cameras, NVRs and remote viewing

items.title: Handyman & mounting
items.tagline: Your to-do list, taken care of.
items.description: Practical help for the small projects that make a big difference, from furniture assembly to the finishing touches on your walls.

bullets.text: Blinds, curtain rods and screen repairs
Door handles, drywall patches and touch-up paint

items.title: Minor electrical updates
items.tagline: Better light. A more useful space.
items.description: Replace worn fixtures and plan everyday upgrades. Share photos of your existing setup so the scope and applicable requirements can be confirmed.

items.title: Small plumbing jobs
items.description: Help with straightforward fixture replacements and minor drain clogs. Send a photo and a description so we can discuss the right approach.

bullets.text: Minor clog clearing with a 25-foot auger
